description: Stateless NACL for the public subnet 10.20.4.0/24 (load balancer). app = 10.20.0.0/22, management = 10.20.5.128/27. Rules are evaluated from the lowest number up; first match wins; anything unmatched is denied.

inbound.comment: known abusive range: blocked on every port, before any allow rule
SSH only from the management subnet
replies from the app subnet (app:8000 -> LB ephemeral port)

outbound.comment: replies to clients anywhere (client ephemeral ports)
